name: repo-cleaner
description: On-demand repo cleanup: audit every branch (merge or delete), drive every open PR to closure (merge when green, close when stale or superseded), and close every resolved or stale issue. Goal is convergence to zero open items. Combines branch-audit discipline with PR merge/close and issue-triage logic. Use when explicitly asked to clean up a repo, reach 0 open items, or batch-close accumulated branches/PRs/issues.
